entities.name: Petralona Cave Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Anthropological Museum of Petralona was thirty-five kilometres from Thessaloniki, in Central Macedonia, Greece. It displayed finds from the nearby Petralona cave, in which the oldest European hominid skull was found.
